name: Droid 2

images.credit: Jourdan Cameron, CC BY 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: Droid 2: CDMA2000/EV-DO Rev. A 800/1900 MHz, Milestone 2: quad band GSM, UMTS 900/2100 MHz, Droid 2 Global: quad band GSM, UMTS 850/1900/2100 MHz, CDMA 800/1900 MHz

Body.Other: Virtual QWERTY keyboard, Swype, physical keyboard (QWERTY keyboard)

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.2, 2.3.4 Gingerbread with over-air update August 2011, 4.0.4 Ice Cream Sandwich with custom ROMs
Platform.CPU: 1 GHz OMAP 3630 Droid 2 Global runs an OMAP3640 clocked at 1.2 GHz

Memory.Storage: 8 GB onboard phone, SD card up to 32 GB (included 8 GB MicroSD Card)

Display.Display: 480×854 px (0.41 MP) TFT LCD, 3.7 in, 16:9 aspect ratio, WVGA

Cameras.Rear camera: 5.0 MP, autofocus, dual LED flash, digital zoom, geotagging

Battery.Battery: 1400 mAh internal rechargeable removable lithium-ion polymer battery, Talk time: 9.58 hours, Standby time: up to 315 hours

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.1, HTML web browser, synchronization, Wi-Fi, WLAN, 3G Mobile Hotspot
